_description: GoldFlow Pure-SMC Version 1 - Frozen Rule Set for Phase 4 primary evaluation.
_frozen_phase: Phase 4 - SMC Strategy Validation and Robustness Testing

strategy_rules.setup_type: Liquidity Sweep => Opposite CHoCH => Order-Block Retest/Rejection
strategy_rules.long_sequence: Sell-side pool swept => Bullish CHoCH from bearish prior trend => Bullish OB retest-rejection signals entry
strategy_rules.short_sequence: Buy-side pool swept => Bearish CHoCH from bullish prior trend => Bearish OB retest-rejection signals entry

swing_identification.algorithm: Strict fractal pivot: high at bar i strictly exceeds k bars on both sides; equal-high plateaus NOT pivots

choch_definition.type: Close-based structure break opposite to established trend
choch_definition.bullish_choch: Close strictly above latest confirmed swing-high when prior trend is BEARISH
choch_definition.bearish_choch: Close strictly below latest confirmed swing-low when prior trend is BULLISH

sweep_identification.buy_side_sweep: high > pool_level AND close < pool_level same candle
sweep_identification.sell_side_sweep: low < pool_level AND close > pool_level same candle

liquidity_pool.buy_side_pool: Two confirmed swing highs within 0.50 price units
liquidity_pool.sell_side_pool: Two confirmed swing lows within 0.50 price units
liquidity_pool.level: arithmetic midpoint of first matched pair

order_block.long_ob_origin: Most recent bearish candle before bullish CHoCH
order_block.short_ob_origin: Most recent bullish candle before bearish CHoCH

retest_conditions.rejection: Long: close above ob.high. Short: close below ob.low
retest_conditions.invalidation: Long: close below ob.low. Short: close above ob.high

entry.rule: Next bar open after signal candle

risk_management.sizing_basis: Realized equity at start of entry bar

concurrency.policy: First eligible signal per bar; subsequent skipped

end_of_data.policy: Force close at last close with spread/slippage
end_of_data.label: END_OF_DATA

scope_warnings: Rules frozen for Phase 4. Do NOT change to improve in-sample results.
No ICT-specific rules included (no FVG, displacement, kill zones, MSS, CE, SMT).
Cash P&L uses empirically-reconciled linear contract formula verified by MT5 order_calc_profit.
Data provenance: UNVERIFIED_PROVENANCE - declared as MT5, not independently authenticated.
In-sample profitability is NOT evidence of a repeatable edge.
Do not optimize parameters on validation or holdout segments.
